issues.event: Databricks launches Genie Code and acquires Quotient AI
issues.article_text: A Databricks lançou o Genie Code, agente autônomo para engenharia de dados com taxa de sucesso de 77,1% vs. 32,1% dos concorrentes, e simultaneamente adquiriu a Quotient AI para avaliação contínua.
issues.detail: PR Newswire press release dated March 11. The research window opens March 12 10:00 BRT — announcement is one day early.
